candidates.name: Hemangiopericytoma
support_spans: Histopathological examination demonstrated spindle cells forming masses with branching ectatic vasculature, focal collagenous regions, and up to 20 mitoses per ten high-power fields.

Immunohistochemical studies showed strong immunoreactivity for CD31, CD99, and Fli-1, with scattered S100-positive cells, and negative staining for CD34, EMA, desmin, muscle-specific actin, and Bcl-2.
candidates.why: The patient's histopathological examination and immunohistochemical studies are consistent with Hemangiopericytoma, a rare neoplastic disease.
